subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-09-10
html:
SE Ranking's connector finally re-authenticated this session (1st live pull since 2026-08-31, after 3 straight sessions locked out). Full re-pull found no new human-independent content gap — the emerging MCP-cluster demand (Meta Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, Mailchimp MCP) is all real and growing, but every one of those connectors is still coming_soon and now 2–5 months past its own ETA, so no page was built for them (would overclaim a connector that doesn't exist). Shipped the standing technical item instead: site-wide security headers.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
Site-wide (all routes)Added 5 security headers via next.config.mjs — X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security. Closes README.md P1 #14's 'add security headers' quick win.N/A — technical/trust correctness fix, not keyword-targetedaskarlo.app — check response headers via browser devtools or curl -I

Rankings/backlinks (fresh pull): avg position still flat at 100 (0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked) every day for the last month — unchanged since kickoff. Backlinks ticked 2→3 (1 new referring domain) — the first movement in 6+ weeks, though still incidental, not a shipped directory listing (off-page Phase 1 remains 0 of 6). Domain trust holds at 5, still indexed by Google.

Next: Two more items from the same security-headers quick win remain human-gated — making www a permanent redirect (Vercel dashboard config, not code) and IndexNow (needs a human decision, since this sandbox can't verify an actual ping to api.indexnow.org). A real Content-Security-Policy is also still open — deliberately not attempted unattended, since it needs live testing against every third-party script the site loads. If any of the 5 overdue catalog.ts connectors (Shopify most overdue at 5+ months, then Meta Ads, HubSpot, Mailchimp) ship, that's an immediate new connector-page opportunity with real, already-confirmed search demand.
